title: Los Retros Frontman Charged in Ventura County; Label Cuts Ties
excerpt: Mauricio “Mauri” Tapia of Los Retros faces four felony counts in Ventura County, and his label Stones Throw Records says it is cutting ties. He has not entered a plea.
content:
VENTURA COUNTY, California — Mauricio “Mauri” Tapia, the 26-year-old frontman of the Oxnard indie band Los Retros, has been charged with four felony counts of unlawful acts with a child under the age of 10, Ventura County Superior Court records show.

Tapia was arrested on October 8 and booked into the Ventura County jail on October 9, with bail set at $3 million, according to USA TODAY, the Ventura County Star and Paste Magazine. Prosecutors filed the charges on October 12, along with special allegations that the victim was vulnerable and that Tapia took advantage of a position of trust. The Ventura County Sheriff’s Office is investigating. No further details about the allegations have been released.

Tapia has not entered a plea, and his next court appearance is scheduled for October 22. He is presumed innocent unless proven guilty.

Label moves to cut ties

Stones Throw Records, the Los Angeles label behind Los Retros, said on October 15 that it learned of the allegations the day before and is taking steps to disassociate itself from Tapia and his work. The label said Tapia’s performance at its Stones Throw 30 festival had been cancelled before it became aware of the allegations.

A fast rise from Oxnard

Tapia founded Los Retros in Oxnard in 2016, blending indie rock with the sound of 1970s Latin balladeers. The band’s breakout song, “Someone To Spend Time With,” has passed 200 million streams, and the group drew roughly 2.8 million monthly listeners on Spotify. Los Retros performed at Coachella in April 2026 and released the album “Odisea” on April 3.

Reporting based on USA TODAY, the Ventura County Star, and Paste Magazine.

If you or someone you know needs help, the National Sexual Assault Hotline is 1-800-656-4673 (RAINN).

— Walter Webb & Willa Webb, News Anchors, Webb Watch 956
